notes: Corrected כַּכָּתוּב → 'as it is written': the assimilated article on the substantival participle takes the supplied 'it' under rule 41 rather than standing unrepresented beside a participle holding the pronoun. Flagged fusions יַעֲבִירוּ קוֹל → 'proclaim' and עֵץ שֶׁמֶן → 'wild olive' reviewed morpheme by morpheme and retained: in each, no English word renders either morpheme alone.
